title: urospermum picroides
intro: Urospermum picroides, commonly known as Hawkbit, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the daisy family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral effects. The therapeutic actions of Urospermum picroides include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents like sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
